definitions.full: H3281. Yalam יַעְלָם proper name, masculine Edomite Gen 36:5 , 14 , 18 = 1Chr 1:35 , Ιεγλομ . II. עלם (√ of following; perhaps originally be mature (sexually); Aramaic עֲלֵם be strong , rejuvenate (certainly denominative), Arabic be lustful ( id. ); compare Sabean עֿלמן עֿלם, young man CIS iv. pp. 30, 42 , Arabic id. ; Phoenician עלמת girl ; Nabataean, Palmyrene עלים עלם, slave , Palmyrene feminine plural harlots ; עוּלֵּמְתָּא עוּלֵּימָא, ᵑ7 Syriac , young man, young woman ).
